human_plan_section: 下一轮：论文正式全量仿真计划
primary_questions: new complete geometric mapping versus designated direct set decoder on identical noisy measurements
cooperative coverage versus independent coverage with the identical M3 learner

world.material_map: existing fixed H0 W1a glass/concrete mesh; pin effective asset hashes before execution
world.noise: existing fixed variance; reference_frobenius_snr_db=30 at reference_gain_db=-90
world.frontend: existing frozen pure-noise-calibrated MUSIC plus joint LS; do not recalibrate
world.reference: noiseless CSI through identical frozen frontend
world.angle_convention: canonical horizontal-UCA mirror representative; no physical hemisphere rejection

I-D.features: G0; includes public LoS/single-reflection descriptors; not a geometry-free baseline
I-D.sampling: same K-preserving spatial replay as M3; new retraining, not historical uniform I-D
I-D.do_not_substitute: M0/Lf_replay is geometric hybrid and is not I-D

P-G.score: 0.9 normalized committee disagreement plus 0.1 historical coverage

queries.distribution: natural safe airspace volume times road arc length, equal weight
queries.selection_filter: geometry safety and exact-coordinate deduplication with historical selection queries only; no reference K/power/performance filters
queries.evaluator: separate offline process reading checkpoints, no performance feedback to policy

learning.sampling: half uniform frames, half within-K equal spatial cells; empirical K marginal preserved
learning.warm_start: all valid noisy history in the current formal seed only
learning.invalid_measurements: keep attempts and quality; no fabricated labels

M3.architecture_and_loss: exact existing selected candidate_level.py with no model search

planning.motion_and_safety: existing H0 primitives, road and speed limits, full-trajectory probe utility and recoverability
planning.candidate_rng: same per-pair/per-window stream; actual coordinates may differ after vehicle states differ

pairing_and_reuse.I_D_and_I_G: same I collector records, validity, timestamps and minibatches
pairing_and_reuse.M3_initial_fork: deep copy weights, optimizer, samplers, torch/CUDA RNG and vehicle state for I-G/C-G/P-G
pairing_and_reuse.costs: shared actual costs counted once; also report complete standalone method costs

statistics.replicate_unit: paired seed, n=10; not query, frame or committee member
statistics.global_metric: sqrt(equal-weight mean of per-query squared GOSPA), then summarize across seeds
statistics.primary_endpoint: global GOSPA at net sensing 240 min
statistics.relative_improvement_percent: 100 * (1 - E_method / E_control), computed per seed before averaging
statistics.confidence_interval: paired Student t on 10 seed differences/improvements; df=9; 95% intervals labelled unadjusted
statistics.significance_claims: two-sided paired t with Holm correction across the two primary comparisons, family alpha=0.05, positive effect required
statistics.secondary_auc: trapezoidal integral of squared global GOSPA over 30..240 min divided by 210 min; no extrapolation to zero
statistics.zero_denominator: NA plus absolute quantities; never silently omit

execution_order: environment and effective scientific configuration checks
isolated runner adaptation and relevant contract tests
seed5099 two-full-window engineering smoke plus eight-window budget dry check
source/assets/effective-config/query freeze before any formal outcome
all ten paired formal seeds, no outcome-dependent alteration
offline evaluation, integrity audit, figures and update sole human ledger

resource_plan.precision: existing validated complex precisions, network FP32, metric FP64
resource_plan.eta: hours scale only; replace with measured per-window estimate after implementation and engineering smoke, no hard deadline

storage.human_report: update existing single FINAL_REPORT_CN.md; do not create scattered report markdown files
storage.records: one HDF5 keyed by seed and I/C/P streams; shared initial and I records stored once
storage.raw_S_retention: first 8 frames per stream, global_probe_index modulo 100 equals 0, and all invalid/anomalous frames
storage.predictions: decoded predictions and per-query error decomposition at all eight updates; full candidate raw/logits only at terminal and prespecified diagnostics

completion_and_failure_rules.hardware_failures: log original failure, deterministic same-seed resume from committed checkpoint; adjust runtime concurrency only
completion_and_failure_rules.scientific_or_isolation_defects: stop affected work, record repair, refreeze and consistently recompute all affected comparisons; no algorithm-version mixing
completion_and_failure_rules.unrecoverable_seed: mark incomplete, report reason, do not replace
completion_and_failure_rules.paper_response_to_negative_results: narrow contribution claims; do not append new experiments

must_exist_before_execution: relevant contract test and smoke results

ledger_revision.reason: append paper formal simulation plan only; original completed results and historical archive preserved byte-for-byte after removing additions
